name: RenderLite
description: High CPU priority, no power throttling and a precise timer for Geometry Dash on Windows.

high-priority.name: High priority (Windows)
high-priority.description: Sets the game's process priority to High automatically. Turn off to return to Normal.

disable-throttling.name: Disable power throttling (Windows)
disable-throttling.description: Stops Windows from limiting the game's CPU speed to save power. Turn off to let Windows decide again.

precise-timer.name: Precise timer (Windows)
precise-timer.description: Requests a 1 ms system timer for more even frame pacing. Turn off to use the Windows default.
